scope: Eight local-news publishers, plus a News4JAX article and a First Coast News article. No accounts, subscriptions, downloads, or paywall changes. Live results are regional, auction-dependent observations, not a coverage guarantee.
method: Shared-browser inspection followed by separate fresh baseline/protected Chromium profiles. Default protection on all 10 URLs; four optional protections on four homepages. Follow-ups verified a nested sticky ad sidebar and accessible Play controls.
changes: Unpin MileTech ad boxes and ad-only sidebars observed on News4JAX, preserving mixed editorial sidebars.
Anchor the First Coast News universal ad and its close button to the existing page placeholder.
Return WESH bottom ad rails to document flow, without matching unrelated sticky controls.
Add the exact Pushly SDK script to optional notification-request blocking after observing it on Orlando Sentinel.
limitations: The shared browser could not access the Florida Times-Union or St. Augustine Record; both loaded in automated fresh profiles.

WFLA loaded in the shared browser but returned HTTP 403 in both baseline/protected automated profiles. First Coast News article returned HTTP 403 in both. Those automated content checks are inconclusive.

The initial WESH sample found an inner Play button obscured by another player control/consent overlay. The live checker was corrected to try accessible Play video controls and preserve other observations if no control can be clicked. The follow-up played video in both profiles.
Live banner creatives vary between auctions; missing creatives are inconclusive, not proof the extension removed them. The optional-settings samples do not establish live banner preservation.
Initial News4JAX styles released the inner ad but not an ad-only sticky ancestor. A targeted ancestor rule and positive/negative fixtures were added; the follow-up includes its resulting position.
